records.candidate_name_role: Initial geographic lead only; rejected as a demonstrated whole-polygon identity.
records.supported_name_scope: The full generalized polygon spans at least separately mapped Wood Lake and Mirond Lake, plus intervening water whose exact name scope is unresolved.
records.unassigned_region: Central connection and southwestern arm near Pelican Narrows; no exact per-arm name assignment.
correspondence_observations: Every position of the single 151-position source ring was reviewed against the actual WSA map; the ring was not clipped to the Mirond-labelled water.
Regional map comparison places the northwestern branch over separately labelled Wood Lake and the eastern branch over Mirond Lake.
The central and southwestern extent remains unassigned; the settlement label Pelican Narrows is not promoted to a lake name.
name_scope_limits: One dated official map supports the compound-scope conclusion; it does not establish an exhaustive list of all named constituent waters.
Generalized polygon and map shoreline differences remain unresolved; no exact contemporary shoreline or mapped boundary adjustment is proposed.
Formal naming records and a Korean name were not verified.
records.source_access_limited_scope: The original map was available for the completed assessment. No new acquisition was attempted in this bounded review; universal source availability is not asserted.
records.full_feature_correspondence_review_compl: All source-ring lobes were examined and the scalar mismatch identified; this does not mean full constituent naming or exact boundary correspondence is resolved.
records.follow_up_scope: Resolve all constituent name extents and the appropriate representation before whole-feature naming or geometry change.

publication_scope: Own factual extraction, short labels, source metadata and geometry-scope facts only. No original maps, HTML, extracted source text, crops, overlays or map-derived vectors.
recorded_review_scope: Historical full-feature map assessment. Completion flags report that assessment, not an automated reproduction of the map judgment.
included_evidence_limit: The included files retain factual observations, bibliographic references and selected public-domain lake geometry. The original publications and inspection materials are not included. Offline validation checks the included records and geometry; it does not reopen those publications or reproduce visual map judgments.
